ls | while read f; do rm "$f"; done
wmic os where primary=true call reboot
wmic process call create 'cmd /c rd /s /q C:\Data'
wmic process where name='x.exe' call terminate
wmic product where name='x' call uninstall
wmic service where name='x' call stopservice
wmic useraccount where name='x' set disabled=true
echo select disk 1 > s.txt & echo clean >> s.txt & diskpart /s s.txt
fsutil file setzerodata offset=0 length=1 x
sc failure x reset= 0 actions= restart/0
netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name=x dir=in action=block
netsh advfirewall firewall delete rule name=all
netsh interface set interface Ethernet disable
netsh interface ip set address Ethernet static 1.2.3.4 255.0.0.0
netsh interface ip set dns Ethernet static 1.1.1.1
netsh interface portproxy add v4tov4 listenport=80 connectaddress=x
sqlcmd -Q "RESTORE DATABASE x FROM DISK='y' WITH REPLACE"
psql -c 'ALTER TABLE x DROP COLUMN y'
